attribution: Salamander Grand Piano by Alexander Holm (axeldenstore@gmail.com), licensed under CC BY 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/)
notes: Yamaha C5, 48kHz/24bit, 641 FLACs in samples/. Note samples: <Note><Octave>v<1-16>.flac (e.g. A0v1..A0v16, C8v16) at minor-third spacing on notes A, C, D#, F# of each octave, 16 velocity layers. 88 release samples rel1.flac..rel88.flac (one per key, numbered chromatically from A0). String-resonance harmonics: harmS/harmL/harmV+<note> (short/long pedal-down harmonics). Pedal noises: pedalU1/pedalU2 (up), pedalD1/pedalD2 (down). Two SFZ files at dir root: SalamanderGrandPiano-V3+20200602.sfz and SalamanderGrandPianoRetuned-V3+20200602.sfz (retuned variant fixes stretch tuning); parse SFZ for exact key/velocity mapping.

notes: License confirmed in bundled REAMDE file (sic): 'Licence: CC-by-sa 3.0'. WAV 48kHz. All samples in OH/ folder (overhead mic mix only in this distribution). Naming: <articulation>_OH_<dynamic>_<roundrobin>.wav, e.g. kick_OH_P_3.wav, snare2OFF_OH_F_10.wav, hihatSemiOpen7_OH_F_3.wav. Dynamics: PP/P/MP/MF/F/FF plus Ghost for snare; FEW velocity layers (often 2) but MANY round robins per layer (closed hat has 20 RRs). SFZ files at root: ALL.sfz (whole kit), kick.sfz, snare.sfz, hihat.sfz, ride.sfz, hitom.sfz, lotom.sfz, crashesFX.sfz — parse these for MIDI note/velocity mapping. Kit: 18x18 kick, 12x7 rack tom, 14x14 floor tom, 2 snares, hihat, multiple Paiste/Stagg/Masterworks cymbals.

LICENSE (CC0) and Readme.txt kept at vsco2_ce_strings/ root; .git dir retained (blob:none partial clone).

attribution: AVL Drumkits (Black Pearl 5-piece, Red Zeppelin 4-piece) by Glen MacArthur / bandshed.net, licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0. Site states attribution is required if you modify or redistribute the samples themselves (which MP3 conversion does).
notes: Two kits: avl_drums/BLACK_PEARL_2023_repack (129 files incl. Black_Pearl_2023_repack.sfz) and avl_drums/RED_ZEPPELIN_2023_repack (129 files incl. Red_Zeppelin_2023_repack.sfz). Flat folders, WAV naming: <midiNote>-<Brand>-<size>-<Articulation>-<n>.wav e.g. 36-Pearl-22-Kick-1.wav, 51-Zildjian-24-Ride-3.wav. The -1..-5 suffix is a TRUE VELOCITY LAYER, not round robin: sfz maps lovel/hivel bands 1-26/27-52/53-77/78-102/103-127 per numbered sample. MIDI note is the filename prefix (GM drum mapping). SFZ has 128 lovel/hivel region lines per kit — parse it for exact mapping. No license file inside zips; license documented at https://bandshed.net/avldrumkits/.
